name: Play My Obsession On Repeat
source:
Take on the role of the sexy (but sadistic and sociopathic) Demon Lord whose castle is under siege by a handsome hero in this reverse rogue-like visual novel!

Watch as the hapless hero dies time and time again, much to the Demon Lord's delighted diversion and thrilled titilation!

But will the Demon Lord be able to make the hero his in the end?

...or, better question, is there actually any way the hero can avoid that fate, considering that the Demon Lord is the one who keeps reviving him every time he dies?

[from [url=https://pyrrhaiphis.itch.io/play-my-obsession-on-repeat]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这部反向Rogue风格的视觉小说中，扮演性感（但虐待狂和反社会）恶魔领主的角色，他的城堡被英俊的英雄围攻！

看着不幸的英雄一次又一次死去，这让恶魔领主感到高兴和兴奋！

但魔王最终能否将英雄收为己有呢？

…或者，更好的问题是，考虑到恶魔领主是每次他死后都不断复活他的英雄，实际上有什么方法可以避免这种命运吗？

[来自[url=https://pyrrhaiphis.itch.io/play-my-obsession-on-repeat]Itch.io[/url]]
